# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, broad, expressionless face covered in freckles. He has a broad, smiling countenance and is known to grin and chuckle frequently when spoken to.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, quiet, and suffers from a severe lack of conversational gifts, often unable to think of a reply until it is too late. He is good-natured, hard-working, and dependable, without any bad habits. Though painfully bashful in social settings, he is capable of great pride and happiness when pleased.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Abilities

- Farming  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Anne Shirley or Nettie Blewett and settle down on his farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)</sub>

## History

Billy grew up in Avonlea as part of the prominent Andrews family. He drove Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and his sister Jane to a concert at the White Sands Hotel, where he sat in wait for them during the event due to his extreme shyness. Deeply admiring Anne Shirley, he watched her quietly for years at social gatherings like school parties. When his father deeded the upper farm to him in his own name, Billy wished to marry Anne but was too shy to court her himself. He persuaded his sister Jane to propose to Anne on his behalf, offering to wait until she finished college. After Anne refused him, he turned his affections to Nettie Blewett, whom he subsequently married and brought to live on his family's pew in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
